description: On-street Car Parking Meters with Location is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Upcoming Changes: Please note that our parking system is being improved and this dataset may be disrupted. See more information here. This dataset shows the location and information about council's on-street car parking meters. It contains information about the parking meter model type, if the model accepts credit card and tap 'n go facilities. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are car, machine, meters, parking, ticket, transport. The portal shows 1,397 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-10-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
